chunks: Regarding a man who confessed that he had usurped another man's bondwoman, and the bondwoman had given birth from the usurper, he said: "The bondwoman and her child are returned to the one wronged, if he confesses to that or there is evidence against him."

key_terms.أَقَرَّ: confessed or admitted the wrongful act
key_terms.اَلْغَاصِبِ: the usurper who committed the wrongful seizure
key_terms.اَلْمَغْصُوبِ: the one whose property was wrongfully taken
key_terms.غَصَبَ: forcibly usurped or unlawfully seized property

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man usurps another person's bondwoman and she bears him a child?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the usurpation of a bondwoman and the status of the child born from that wrongful seizure. It states that both the bondwoman and her child are to be returned to the wronged owner when the usurper confesses or when proof is established against him.
